text: Basic Electronics Co. Ltd. (Al-Asasyah, the BASIC brand) is a Limited Liability Company owned by Mr. Mohammad Ahmad Al Arfaj, its chairman; the company describes itself as 100% Saudi-owned, with Al Arfaj family members in management.
short: Basic Electronics is owned by founder Mohammad Ahmad Al Arfaj and family.
